decisions.reason: GitGuardian follow-up on March LiteLLM PyPI supply-chain compromise: Hudson Rock and CloudSEK analyses of exfiltration archive (153GB RAR, 433,909 files, 118,829 CI runner dumps, 2,488 corporate domains). Same incident as canonical LiteLLM blast-radius story.

SocFortress technical analysis of DeadLock ransomware (Rust encryptor, decentralized Web3/onion-routed recovery, double extortion, 80+ victims, Lynx/INC affiliates). Same ransomware family and story as canonical DeadLock blockchain-takedown-resistance story.

decisions.story_title: Hackers arrested over €30M bank fraud exploiting service provider flaw
decisions.reason: BleepingComputer: four arrested in Brazil, three charged in Europe over November 2023 theft of ~EUR 30M from Commerzbank customer accounts via a service provider software vulnerability; BKA and Brazilian federal police investigation.
